items.reply: I change my classification to TP/nit. The base UI called saveWithUsernames → update_put → Group#usernames=, which batched user lookups with User.where; the new UI calls add_members, which executes User.find_by_username for every supplied username. This changes the active UI path, so the relocation ruling does not apply despite the similar old update_patch loop. The extra lookups are a minor optimization opportunity in this admin-only action, with no demonstrated meaningful performance impact, warranting low severity.
